item.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Juniper Products Could Allow for Arbitrary Code Execution
item.description: Multiple vulnerabilities have been discovered in Juniper Session Smart Router and Session Smart Conductor, the most severe of which could allow for arbitrary command execution as root. Session Smart Router is Juniper’s software-based SD-WAN router, and Session Smart Conductor is the management and orchestration platform for a fleet of these routers. Successful exploitation of the most severe of these vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-103406) could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the affected Conductor.
